title: Review (Supported for S, I, D; E by construction) of the fed vortices on fresh seeds 54-55: 52 and 38 persistent splits to generation 10 (merge/split 0.85-0.87), every vortex out within ~80 t of the fuel fork; the no-advection twin still splits to generation 3 (13 splits)
summary: Re-ran the claimed world on seeds 54 and 55 with the fuel fork and the no-advection twin on seed 54. Vortices of both signs form from band-passed random vorticity, stretch into rods and pinch into two same-sign vortices to generation 10 on both seeds; same-sign fusions keep the genealogy reticulate. Emptying the fuel at t=2000 puts out all 27-29 vortices by t=2079 while the fed twin keeps 27-31. With advection off the reaction-diffusion still divides, but 4x less and only to generation 3.

observations.I: rerun/seed54/sheet.png: 25-31 discrete vortices of both signs persisting between collisions
observations.D: rerun/seed54 and seed55 FACTS.md: 52 / 38 persistent splits, generation 10 / 10, merge/split 0.85 / 0.87; strips_s55.png rows 2 and 4 rods pinching into two vortices

seeds_run.result: pass: 52 persistent splits, generation 10; fork 0 bodies by t 2079

controls_run.E: fork/ (fuel emptied at t=2000, seed 54) vs rerun/seed54

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds at 128^2, no resolution or dt test of my own. The genealogy is reticulate (merge/split 0.85-0.87). The no-advection twin still divides to generation 3 on my seed, so the flow deepens division rather than creating it; I do not mark D as beyond diffusion. Strips at 25 t spacing make two of four drawn splits hard to read.
